summary: Complaints centre on the damaged Ganga bridge at Anupshahr town, a 10-hour pilgrim jam, the 10-metre Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway and seasonal Ganga floods, while appreciation is thin and limited to hourly roadways buses and a started bridge repair.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row 67: Anupshahr, district Bulandshahr, reservation None); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anupshahr_Assembly_constituency (number 67, district Bulandshahr, reservation None; tehsils Anupshahr and Bulandshahr; kanungo circles Anupshahr, Jahangirabad and Aurangabad)

positives.english: Roadways buses run from Bulandshahr to Anupshahr every hour
positives.hindi: बुलंदशहर से अनूपशहर के लिए हर घंटे रोडवेज बस मिलती है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr): the article says hourly service to Anupshahar is already running from about 6:30 AM to 6:30 PM from the Bulandshahr Roadways stand; the depot will add buses before Chhath and every 30 minutes at Kartik Purnima crowds (planned). No residents quoted. Service status after Oct 2025 not verified

positives.english: Repair work on the Anupshahr Ganga bridge is starting
positives.hindi: अनूपशहर गंगा पुल की मरम्मत का काम शुरू होने जा रहा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Apr 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau): PWD repair and strengthening of the dilapidated Ganga bridge at Anupshahr; route closed for about 15 days with diversions; article says work begins Wednesday 8 Apr 2026 at 7 AM. Headline says 'begins today', body gives the Wednesday date. No completion date stated; no residents quoted; whether the work finished is not found in any source checked

positives.english: *Flood-hit farmers in UP got Rs 493 crore input subsidy in their bank accounts
positives.hindi: *बाढ़ से नुकसान वाले किसानों के खाते में 493 करोड़ रुपये आए
positives.basis: Inference: statewide DBT payment of Rs 493 crore to 9,18,091 farmers announced 12 Oct 2026 (AIR/newsonair) for losses from floods, heavy rain, hailstorm and cyclone. Neither Anupshahr nor Bulandshahr is named in the article, so local receipt is not confirmed. Weak positive pending field check

positives.english: *Roadways buses are planned from Shikarpur to Anupshahr and Pahasu
positives.hindi: *शिकारपुर से अनूपशहर के लिए रोडवेज बसें चलने की योजना है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025, Ghaziabad): Bulandshahr depot plans two buses each on Shikarpur-Anupshahr and Shikarpur-Pahasu routes; article says 'planned, not yet running', villages being surveyed, no start date. Not confirmed running

positives.english: *Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway four-lane proposal has gone to the state for approval
positives.hindi: *बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क को चार लेन करने का प्रस्ताव शासन को भेजा गया
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026): PWD sent a Rs 175 crore four-lane proposal to the state; approval expected in about two months; construction to start in phases after approval; no start or completion date. This is an announcement only, which the template does not count as a positive; listed because it is the only other planned benefit found for Anupshahr

negatives.english: The Ganga bridge at Anupshahr has deep potholes and iron rods showing
negatives.hindi: अनूपशहर का गंगा पुल खस्ताहाल है, सरिया तक बाहर दिख रहा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau): deep potholes in several places, iron rods exposed, drivers facing difficulty. PWD Assistant Engineer Satyendra Chaudhary said heavy traffic vibration causes the potholes and patch repairs would be done soon, with full fix after festivals because of labour shortage. Article says potholes were filled several times earlier but repairs did not last

negatives.english: A 10-hour jam in Anupshahr when pilgrims crowded the Ganga for Shraddh Purnima bath
negatives.hindi: श्राद्ध पूर्णिमा पर गंगा स्नान की भीड़ में अनूपशहर में 10 घंटे जाम
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau): jam lasted about 10 hours from late Friday night to Saturday afternoon; queues from Mastram Ghat to Roopwas, about 5 km on Anupshahar-Dibai road, about 2 km on Anupshahar-Bulandshahr road up to Karanpur village, and the Anupshahar Adda to Bulandshahr Adda bypass. SP Dehat and CO Bharat Sonkar cleared it; CO blamed wrong-way driving and parking. No future measures announced; no residents quoted

negatives.english: Ganga flood covered Anupshahr ghats and the road to Gangadwar, and farm crops went under water
negatives.hindi: गंगा उफान पर है, घाट डूबे और गंगा द्वार की सड़क तक पानी आ गया
negatives.basis: Patrika (31 Jul 2026, Anupshahr, Bulandshahr): Bijnor barrage release raised Ganga about 2.5 feet in 24 hours at Anupshahr; several ghats submerged; water reached the Jahnavi Platform and main road to Gangadwar; villages Ahar, Mubarakpur, Margpur, Sirora, Torai and Bachchi Khera under water; maize, jowar, bajra and sugarcane submerged or at risk; green fodder short. Administration says situation under control. Ahar and Sirora (Serora) fall in the AC extent per Wikipedia

negatives.english: The Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway is only 10 metres wide with about 1.5 lakh vehicles a day
negatives.hindi: बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क सिर्फ 10 मीटर चौड़ी है, रोज डेढ़ लाख गाड़ियां चलती हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): district's busiest state highway, 10 m wide after widening about eight years ago from 7 m; about 1.5 lakh vehicles daily; accidents during overtaking; jams for hours in Shravan and festivals when pilgrims go to the Anupshahar Ganga ghat. XEN says Rs 175 crore four-laning proposed. Note: the Bulandshahr end of the road lies outside AC 67 (district-level for that stretch)

negatives.english: Vegetable farmers struggle to reach the Anupshahr and Bulandshahr mandis through morning traffic
negatives.hindi: सुबह के जाम में सब्जी किसान अनूपशहर और बुलंदशहर की मंडी तक नहीं पहुंच पाते
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): article states that morning traffic makes it hard for vegetable farmers from nearby villages to reach the Bulandshahr and Anupshahr mandis. No farmer quoted; the claim is the article's own

notes: Scarce local coverage: the search index had almost no Anupshahr-specific Hindi reporting on water, power, sugarcane dues, stray cattle, health (CHC), schools or jobs, so those topics are absent rather than shown to be fine. Anupshahr town is inside AC 67 under the namesake rule; Ahar and Sirora are inside per the Wikipedia extent. Negative 4 is partly district-level (Bulandshahr end of the highway). Positives 3-5 are weak or unconfirmed: 3 is statewide and not named for Anupshahr, 4 is a plan not running as of Dec 2025, 5 is a proposal, not a delivered benefit. Field check: whether the bridge repair finished after the 15-day closure (article gave no end date); whether hourly buses still run; the Walipura canal car accident near Bulandshahr was not used because it is undated and its location is unclear. Population figures on Wikipedia are 2001 census. A Patrika flood article sits under a bijnor-news URL path but its content concerns Anupshahr, Bulandshahr district.
